notes: Modified cash basis school district; all four funds (General, Depreciation, Special Building, School Nutrition, Activities) are governmental columns in the Total Governmental Funds column of Exhibit III (pp5-10), so no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from the total column (p6, p8); beginning/ending balances p10. Local Receipts split into tax types using Schedule A (p12) and Special Building schedule (p19) plus Activities Fund receipts (p17); the split sums to 2,481,965.09. Debt Services 18,009.74 split into principal/interest from Schedule I (p19); Purchased Services split by fund column (Depreciation 140,027.56 p7, Activities 104,746.01 p8). Transfers 135,400 in and out net to zero. Detail: Schedule M (object by program, pp20-26) supersedes Schedule B (program totals, pp14-15), so B is not recorded; Schedule A-1 (p11) is a summary and not recorded. Detail lines with blank actuals (budget only) are omitted. General Fund 2130 Health Services other lines had blank actuals. Schedule M includes the 135,400 transfer in its total, so those lines are other financing and the total carries includes. The 270,000 Depreciation 'Allocation from General Fund' (code 5200, same code as the Activities/Nutrition 'Transfers From General Fund') is treated as a transfer on both sides: detail has General 4700 Building Improvements as -270,000 other financing (p25) and Depreciation 5200 as +270,000 other financing (p16); at statement level 270,000 was removed from Building Improvements (disbursements, now 0) and from Non-Revenue Receipts (now 6,721.10), and added to transfers_in and transfers_out (405,400 each = 135,400 + 270,000). The printed statement totals (6,098,323.75 receipts, 5,975,972.76 disbursements) still contain the 270,000 (includes_split). See decision_needed. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position (p1), cash basis. Read pages 1-26 of 26
